title: Scientists Link Gene to Human Speech
titleZh: 科学家将基因与人类语言联系起来
credits: Laura Ungar reported this story for the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: A new study suggests the beginnings of human speech are linked to genetics.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究提出，人类语言的起源与遗传有关。

sentences.en: The research identifies a protein – found only in people – that may have helped early humans develop spoken communication.
sentences.zh: 这项研究确定了一种仅存在于人体内的蛋白质，它或许帮助早期人类发展出了口头交流能力。

sentences.en: Scientists involved in the study say this new speaking ability became important for humans’ survival.
sentences.zh: 参与这项研究的科学家表示，这种新的说话能力对人类的重要性体现在生存方面。

sentences.en: For example, speech permitted individuals to share information, organize activities and pass down knowledge.
sentences.zh: 例如，语言使个人能够分享信息、组织活动并传承知识。

sentences.en: These abilities are now seen as an advantage humans had over their relatives, such as the Neanderthals and Denisovans.
sentences.zh: 这些能力如今被视为人类相较于其近亲（如尼安德特人和丹尼索瓦人）所具有的优势。

sentences.en: The researchers recently published their findings in a study in the journal Nature Communications.
sentences.zh: 研究人员最近将他们的研究成果发表在《自然·通讯》期刊上的一篇研究中。

sentences.en: Liza Finestack teaches about speech and hearing at the University of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 莉莎·费恩斯塔克在明尼苏达大学讲授语言与听力相关知识。

sentences.en: Finestack was not involved in the study.
sentences.zh: 费恩斯塔克并未参与这项研究。

sentences.en: Dr. Robert Darnell has long been studying the protein – called NOVA1 – at his laboratory at New York’s Rockefeller University.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·达内尔博士长期以来一直在纽约洛克菲勒大学的实验室里研究这种被称为NOVA1的蛋白质。

sentences.en: He helped lead the new research and was a writer of the study.
sentences.zh: 他帮助领导了这项新研究，并是这篇研究的作者之一。

sentences.en: Darnell told the AP the genetic version, or variant, included the protein that helped humans develop into the “dominant species” that remains today.
sentences.zh: 达内尔向美联社表示，这种遗传版本，即变异体，包含了一种帮助人类发展成为如今依然存在的“优势物种”的蛋白质。

sentences.en: The latest research involved scientists using CRISPR gene editing methods to replace the NOVA1 protein found in mice with the one found in humans.
sentences.zh: 最新这项研究中的科学家使用CRISPR基因编辑技术，将小鼠体内存在的NOVA1蛋白质替换为人体内存在的那种。

sentences.en: The aim was to test the real-life effects of the genetic variant.
sentences.zh: 其目的是测试该基因变异体在现实中的影响。

sentences.en: The researchers were surprised to learn that the variant changed the way the animals called out to each other.
sentences.zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，这种变异体改变了动物彼此间发出叫声的方式。

sentences.en: Baby mice with the human variant made a different sound than normal mice do when their mother came around.
sentences.zh: 携带人类变异体的幼鼠在母亲靠近时会发出与正常小鼠不同的声音。

sentences.en: Adult male mice with the variant also made different sounds when they were near a female they wanted to mate with.
sentences.zh: 携带该变异体的成年雄鼠在靠近它们想要交配雌鼠时也会发出不同的声音。

sentences.en: Darnell said both of these situations gave the mice a reason to speak.
sentences.zh: 达内尔表示，这两种情况都给小鼠提供了“开口说话”的理由。

sentences.en: Those with the human variant "spoke differently," demonstrating the gene’s influence in speech, he added.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，携带人类变异体的小鼠“说话方式不同”，这展示了该基因对语言的影响。

sentences.en: This is not the first time a gene has been linked to speech.
sentences.zh: 这并非首次有基因被与语言联系起来。

sentences.en: In 2001, British scientists said they had discovered the first gene tied to a language and speech disorder.
sentences.zh: 2001年，英国科学家表示他们发现了首个与语言障碍和语言障碍相关的基因。

sentences.en: Researchers called this human language gene FOXP2.
sentences.zh: 研究人员将这种人类语言基因命名为FOXP2。

sentences.en: But even though FOXP2 was found to be linked to human language, the variant in modern humans was not found in our species alone.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管FOXP2被证实与人类语言有关，但现代人身上的这种变异并非我们物种所独有。

sentences.en: Later research found it was shared with Neanderthals.
sentences.zh: 后来的研究发现，它也被尼安德特人所共有。

sentences.en: The NOVA1 variant in modern humans, on the other hand, is found only in our species, Darnell said.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，现代人身上的NOVA1变异只存在于我们物种中，达内尔说。

sentences.en: The presence of a gene variant is not the only thing that permits people to speak.
sentences.zh: 某种基因变异的存在并不是让人能够说话的唯一条件。

sentences.en: The ability also depends on physical elements in the human throat and areas of the brain that work together to help people produce speech and understand language.
sentences.zh: 这种能力还取决于人类喉咙的生理结构以及大脑中协同作用、帮助人们产生语言和理解语言的相关区域。

sentences.en: Darnell said he hopes the recent work can lead to new ways to treat speech-related problems.
sentences.zh: 达内尔表示，他希望近期的研究能够带来治疗语言相关问题的新方法。

sentences.en: The University of Minnesota's Finestack noted the genetic findings could also one day permit scientists to identify people who might need help developing speech and language early in life.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达大学的芬尼斯塔克指出，这些遗传学发现或许有一天能帮助科学家识别出在生命早期可能需要帮助以发展语言和语言能力的个体。

sentences.en: "That's certainly a possibility," she said.
sentences.zh: 那 certainly是一种可能性，她说。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。
